title: L2ContractMigrationFacet '// set global state' comment writes uninitialized (always-zero) totalDeposited/totalDepositedBdv to protocol-wide silo balances
description: In addMigratedDepositsToAccount the comment on line 193 reads '// set global state' before assigning s.sys.silo.balances[token].deposited and .depositedBdv. The stated intent is that the per-token global silo totals are set to reflect the migrated deposits. However the local accumulators `uint128 totalDeposited` and `uint128 totalDepositedBdv` (lines 159-160) are declared and never incremented anywhere in the deposit loop (the loop only increments totalBdvForAccount and accountStalk). The 'global state' written on lines 194-195 is therefore always 0, overwriting the protocol-wide silo totals with zero while per-account deposits are credited. The accompanying behavior diverges from the sibling ReseedSilo.reseedSiloDeposit, which actually accumulates totalCalcDeposited/totalCalcDepositedBdv and validates them with a require before writing global state. The comment asserts a correct global-state update that the code does not perform.
impact: Global deposited/depositedBdv for the migrated token is zeroed while per-account deposits exist, breaking the documented total == sum(accounts) silo invariant. Downstream LibTokenSilo withdraw / LibConvert / BDV getters read the zeroed total, causing withdrawal underflow / DoS or value-accounting inflation.

ite.intent: Stated intent (comment + sibling pattern): set the per-token global silo totals to the sum of the migrated deposits.
ite.technique: Accumulator locals declared but never written, then assigned to global state -> global totals overwritten with 0.
ite.evasion: Permissionless migration call; no guard recomputes or validates the global total in this path.

ice_chain.impact: Accounting desync (total != sum of accounts): withdrawal underflow/DoS or value inflation
ice_chain.consumer_function: LibTokenSilo withdraw / LibConvert / SiloGetters BDV reads of s.sys.silo.balances[token]
ice_chain.exploit_path: redeemDepositsAndInternalBalances -> addMigratedDepositsToAccount writes 0 to global balances -> later withdraw/convert reads inconsistent totals -> underflow or mispriced accounting
